why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Mookie Betts is slot #1 (5.354 expected team runs/game).
Slots #1, #2, #6, #3, #4, #5, #7, #8 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #4 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.006 R/G.
Slot #1 yields 4.81 expected PA/game vs 4.47 at primary slot #4. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
